title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Evans dealing with Achilles soreness
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans is dealing with Achilles soreness.
items.impact: There is no rupture, which is a positive sign after Evans left Monday's game late in the first half. He'll continue to be further evaluated later in the week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Terry McLaurin carted off field during Monday Night Football
items.desc: Terry McLaurin was carted off the field after suffering an apparent leg injury, staying on the ground for several minutes before having an air cast placed on his leg. He has since been ruled out for the remainder of the game. Not a surprise given the circumstances.
items.impact: The injury occurred while McLaurin was trying to run a route late in the first quarter. The whole Washington roster and several of the Niners veterans, including Mike Evans and George Kittle, also came to wish him well. Fantasy managers will need to watch for updates, but expect a lengthy absence. With McLaurin out, Stefon Diggs and Antonio Williams will see an uptick in work, with TE Chig Okonkwo and WR Treylon Burks also filling in some as well.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) on track to play 'in some capacity' in Week 7
items.desc: Zach Charbonnet remains on track to play "in some capacity" in Week 7 against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Charbonnet will continue to practice all week. He'll have to be activated by Thursday, which will be 21 days after they designated him to return to practice. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) to get 'some running in' Tuesday
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said RB Jeremiyah Love will get "some running in" on Tuesday.
items.impact: Love missed Sunday's win over the Rams. The Cardinals will have a better idea of where he's at and what he'll do on Wednesday.

items.title: Jake Moody signs with Ravens' practice squad

items.title: Blake Grupe suffered torn ACL

items.impact: Grupe will officially miss the rest of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
items.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) could practice this week
items.desc: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Lamark Jackson could "potentially" practice this week.
items.impact: Jackson missed a second straight game in Sunday's loss to the Browns. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.desc: The Commanders activated CB Trey Amos from injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs uncertain on availability for Week 7
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said he is undecided on whether or not Josh Jacobs will play in Week 7 against the Lions.
items.impact: LaFleur said Jacobs will practice all week as he was removed from the commissioner exempt list.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) to play in Week 7
items.desc: Tank Dell (knee) will play in Week 7 for the Houston Texans according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Dell will take the field for the first time since December 2024 barring any setbacks in practice this week, as the talented wideout will look to boost a Houston passing attack against the New York Giants Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: C.J. Gardner-Johnson suspended one game
items.desc: C.J. Gardner-Johnson was suspended one game for spitting on Raiders tight end Brock Bowers Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Gardner-Johnson has battled a myriad of injuries while also displaying questionable character at times this season and will now leave the Buffalo secondary undermanned for their upcoming matchup against the Baltimore Ravens in Week 8 after the team's bye.
